title: The persistent read cache stays bounded
description: The persistent read cache stays bounded
acceptance_criteria: after an archive-introduction index is built the cache file holds no approvals.json bytes, and a warm index reads back the same ledgers as a live one; a flush keeps at most 4096 archive-introduction entries and keeps those the command used; a cache file over 8 MiB is not loaded; verdicts and warm-read process bounds are unchanged

answers.constraints: the cache stays an accelerator under the Git common directory, never a project input; a cold read spawns no more Git processes than before; mutating commands keep reading live
